source_review.A1_used_for: exact physical board/socket/card/portion only; no wiring inference

findings: All 15 printed blocks, fields and pin glyphs compared with individual native crops, full-source overview and final public preview.
Negative LAB branch feeds BA and AX at the two printed diamonds; positive LAB branch fans to the right references and AV, with separate powered MA521 output.
Lower ATR decoder has four earlier-bit inputs and a printed AZ B08/D08 local tie without an invented driver; all five AY negation inputs and final MA701 output match the scan.
Right reference fanouts, source UR functions, connector table, revision, date and footer checked.
